analysis.verdict_rule: positive only when the paired relative-effect 95% confidence interval lower bound is at least 0.01

claim: At 48 layers, branch-normalized shared-gate ReZero improves final validation NLL over Pre-RMS by at least 1% under equal token and tuning budgets.

required_conditions: both strategies complete a finite 10-step smoke at the exact model and batch shape
neither strategy exceeds the peak-memory limit
no training or evaluation state is non-finite
feasibility_gate.stop_rule: Do not start the six full runs if either strategy fails the gate.

falsification: The paired 95% confidence interval lower bound is below 1%.
Any condition receives a larger token or tuning budget.
The result depends on excluding a finite completed seed.
stopping_rule: After feasibility passes, run all six condition-seed runs unless the declared failure budget is exceeded; do not stop for an interim positive or negative effect.
